results.note: Symmetric dense-FFN gate+up (n_rows_gate=n_rows_up=local_inter). Both kernels produce bit-exact decode trajectory (last_id=198) — confirms no correctness divergence in the symmetric path. Modest win on the wider hidden=5120.

Asymmetric GDN gate+up (local_conv_channels=2560, local_d_inner=2048). last_id varies across all three (367/97799/220) but warm_argmax=64 holds — F32 reduction-order noise across 64 decode steps, not a correctness bug. Performance: warpcoop64 is 1.5% worse than t128 here, BUT both are slower than the 256t baseline. **Cycle-5 finding (independent of C6): t128 regresses 35B-A3B-Q4_0 by -15.5% vs 256t** (61.47 vs 72.77). This was a cycle-5 oversight — 35B-A3B has hidden=2048 (small), so launch overhead per block hurts more than occupancy helps. Need shape-aware dispatch (filed below).

decision.rationale: Sign flips by model shape (+1.6% on 27B, -2.4% on 35B-A3B). Default stays at t128 (cycle 5) since C6 is not a global win. Cert + dispatch land for future shape-aware routing.

follow_ups.summary: Shape-aware Q4_0 fused gate+up dispatch — pick 256t/t128/warpcoop64 based on (n_rows_gate, n_rows_up, hidden). 35B-A3B's hidden=2048+asymmetric pair belongs in 256t; 27B's hidden=5120+symmetric pair belongs in warpcoop64; t128 is the conservative middle. Needs T-track tuner to autotune on rig.

TP-perf-c5 (t128 default) regresses Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Q4_0 decode by -15.5% vs 256t baseline. Cycle-5 cert only validated on Qwen3.6-27B-Q4_0; needs re-run on hybrid hidden=2048 shapes to either revert default or land shape-aware dispatch.
